name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.

I send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.

All that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.
narrative.objectives: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
narrative.offerRewardText: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Go now, champion. Seek out Ursius.
